## Bounded-scope decisions (recorded honestly)

- **The evidence names the lane, not the label.** Several seats' plan
  labels name a lane (`arcgis_query`, `xlsx_file`, `opendatasoft_dataset`)
  whose concrete endpoint the committed record does NOT carry — the
  candidate URL is a dataset landing page or a truncated slug. Each such
  seat wires on the lane its committed URL DOES serve (CKAN
  `package_show` mints the dataset record + resource pointers; the
  dossier `clause_fields` lane serves the HTML page); the concrete
  endpoint defers to `D-P37.69a-1`'s reviewed preflight — never a
  guessed URL.
- **dados.gov.pt is udata, not CKAN.** Lisboa's seat (I5-C356) rides the
  dossier dataset-page read; its GeoJSON resource URL is
  `D-P37.69a-1`.
- **Novo Mesto's harvest view routes home.** The committed record names
  the data.europa.eu harvest page of the podatki.gov.si dataset — the
  seat wires `package_show` on the origin CKAN portal (recorded in the
  target notes).
- **The Tasmania seat stays enumerated.** The committed slug truncates
  mid-token (`…-cctv-cov`); the seat registers + gates with its
  `promote` disposition standing and an `[[enumerated]]` record —
  never a fetch target.
- **Shared-emit reuse.** The file/ODS camera rows ride `dot_511`'s
  `CameraRegistryEntry` emit (the parcel screen, the tier transform,
  the defect lane) — so those rows carry `dot_511`'s vocab_version
  stamp; the dataset-anchor rows carry this family's. Recorded, not
  hidden.
- **ICO is register-level.** The `new:html_list` per-entry enumeration
  lane is not built — the seat emits register-level facts only
  (`D-P37.69a-2`).
- **OPC seat activation posture.** `statrep_ca_special_parliament_use`
  (I5-C304) carries the C6-conditional IND-TERMS posture — registered
  and gated like every other seat; the operator's flip line decides.
- **Fixture provenance.** Every `p37_69a` fixture is a synthetic
  reconstruction of the served shape — never a fetched capture; the
  README says so.
